name: pavidez-docs
description: PAVIDEZ DOCS — Portal de Documentos da Pavidez Engenharia

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
